pokedexEntries.ru: ANORITH was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive POKéMON once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.

pokedexEntries.sa: ANORITH is said to be a type of POKéMON predecessor, with eight wings at the sides of its body. This POKéMON swam in the primordial sea by undulating these eight wings.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It is a kind of POKéMON progenitor. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.

pokedexEntries.em: It was resurrected from a fossil using the power of science. It swims by undulating the eight wings at its sides. They were feet that adapted to life in the sea.

pokedexEntries.dpp: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

pokedexEntries.hgss: An ancestral Pokémon that lived in the ocean. Over time, its eight feet transformed into wings.

pokedexEntries.bw: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

pokedexEntries.x: It is a kind of Pokémon progenitor. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.

pokedexEntries.y: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

pokedexEntries.or: Anorith was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive Pokémon once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.

pokedexEntries.as: Anorith is said to be a type of Pokémon predecessor, with eight wings at the sides of its body. This Pokémon swam in the primordial sea by undulating these eight wings.

pokedexEntries.us: When restored Anorith are released into the ocean, they don’t thrive, because the water composition has changed since their era.

pokedexEntries.um: This is one kind of primeval bug Pokémon. With eight wings, it could apparently swim a lot faster than you’d expect.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Anorith lived in the ocean about 100,000,000 years ago, hunting with its pair of claws.

pokedexEntries.sh: Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings through the water like oars on a boat. This Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: This Pokémon ancestor was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with its claws.
